overview: The Medford Zoning Board of Appeals held a special meeting to act on two continued items, denying a dimensional variance for a home music studio garage addition on Governors Avenue and approving a special permit for a retail marijuana dispensary on Mystic Avenue.

items.title: 93 Governors Ave Variance Request
items.summary: The board voted 4-1 to deny Leonardo Blanco's request for side and rear yard setback variances to construct an attached two-car garage with a second-floor acoustic music studio after abutters voiced opposition over the building's scale and proximity to lot lines.

items.title: 114 Mystic Ave Special Permit
items.summary: The board unanimously approved a special permit for New England Organics LLC to operate a retail marijuana dispensary at 114 Mystic Ave, attaching conditions requiring traffic safety review for signage placement and good-faith consultations on departmental plans.

items.title: Administrative Updates and Adjournment
items.summary: Staff confirmed member appointment letters were being processed, and the board adjourned without further business.
